Humans need to fight with this `devil' together so that we lose many doctors and nurses. Moreover, during that time, people were in a panic, so they dare not go outside of the door. As a result, the whole economy may have a huge deficit. For society, people always afraid of others so some of them might have guns to protect themselves and this would cause the uncertainty of society. By using the SIR model for the dynamics of an epidemic, we can develop an exact solution of linear differential equations and statistic approaches.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Development and Application of Human Gene Editing: Take Genetically Modified Babies as Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Genetically editing on human embryos have not yet been common used clinically and its feasibility is still in doubt. However, gene editing is always a popular topic in societies. There are already three methods on gene editing, including the zinc finger nucleases (ZNFs) technology, transcription activator like effector nucleases (TALENs) technology and the most recently found CRISPER/Cas9 technology. At the end of 2018, a Chinese professor called He Jiankui announced that two genetically modified babies were born, which caused great attention among public. This article introduces the three gene editing technologies and the whole process of the genetically modified babies' event to give the readers some background knowledge of the issue. Subsequently, the study worked out some considerations of this event from different aspects aiming to have a deep analyze. It is hoped that scientists can raise their awareness on what to do and authorities should at the same time properly interfere and report in the process to supervise. Some ethical problems on applying these technologies to human embryos should also be considered and better to be solved.

articleTitle: Effect of ACA on American Health System : —— Is Affordable Care Act Worth it?
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: The outbreak of COVID-19 makes many people worry about future emergencies, such as certain diseases, so they tend to buy health insurance. The Affordable Care Act which is also called Obamacare is a policy of the United States which was enacted in 2010, and its main purpose is to provide medical insurance to more Americans, but it was abolished in 2017. The purpose of this paper is to examine whether the ACA should be repealed based on figures, tables and different opinions and facts which were collected from online research papers and academic websites. This paper mainly discusses the advantages and disadvantages of the ACA, the negative effects after ACA repealed, and how to improve ACA's shortage. The final conclusion was that the ACA's strengths outweighed its weaknesses and should not be repealed.

Author Keywords: the pros and cons of Affordable Care Act

articleTitle: Bidirectional Pathway Between Depression and Inflammatory Bowel Disease
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Although in the past, scientists have the well understanding of both depression and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn's disease (CD), it is only few decades that the relationship between them has been discussed. Neither depression nor IBD can bring catastrophic damages to a person's life, but many tested evidences illustrate that they have the similar remission and relapse pattern, namely attenuating and exacerbating at the same time. By finding the common pathways or the pertinent effects shared by depression and IBD, we can better understand the etiologies to both of them. There are few studies indicating that the common immune-inflammatory, oxidative and nitrosative stress (O&NS), auto-immune, and tryptophan catabolite (TRYCAT) pathways are present in depression and IBD. Moreover, the paramount part of brain and intestine is the gut-brain axis (GBA). Mounting evidence and an experiment indicate the interlaced consequences from dysfunction of the gut-brain axis, and the inflammatory disease has an impact on the key structure of GBA, amygdala, and the dysfunction of which will change the emotional processing. However, although there is result demonstrating that in depression, levels of TNF α x, IL-6, and β are elevated, the reason is still unclear, and the measurement of cytokines cannot be directly linked to the assessment of depression. In conclusion, the relationship between depression and IBD still has many uncertainties.

articleTitle: Causes and Treatment of Adolescent Depression
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the causes and treatment of adolescent depression. Through knowledge the author has learned in class and the literature review, several causes and treatments of the disease are given. The causes can be divided into genetic factors and environmental factors, and treatments include psychotherapy and drug therapy. The purpose of this article is to let people know more about adolescent depression and make timely prevention or relief. There have been significant advances in drug therapy and psychotherapy research, and cognitive behavior treatment (CBT) is considered more effective.

articleTitle: Construction and implementation effect of Internet + home care mode for postoperative discharged patients in Department of Hepatobiliary Surgery
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Objective: To investigate the Construction and implementation effect of Internet + home care mode for postoperative discharged patients in Department of Hepatobiliary Surgery. Methods: 60 patients discharged from hepatobiliary surgery in our hospital from January 2018 to December 2018 were selected as the study subjects, and the patients were divided into intervention group (30 cases) and control group (30 cases) according to random number table method. The cases in the control group received routine follow up mode management, and the cases in the intervention group adopted the Internet + home care mobile APP management launched by the project group on the basis of the control group. After intervention, the incidence of complications (fever, pipeline blockage, pipeline shedding, biliary tract hemorrhage), infection rate, quality of life and nursing satisfaction were compared between the two groups. Results: The incidence of complications (fever, pipeline blockage, pipeline shedding, biliary hemorrhage) in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (6.67% vs 33.33%, P<; 0.05). The incidence of infection (intra-biliary tract infection, peri-catheter skin infection) in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (10.00% vs 33.33%, P<; 0.05). The physiological function, social function, body function, pain, general health status, vitality, emotional function and mental health in the intervention group were significantly higher than those in the control group (P<; 0.05). The satisfaction of the patients in the control group was 90.0%, and that of the intervention group was 100.0%. The satisfaction of the intervention group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<; 0.05). Conclusion: The establishment of Internet + home care mode has significant advantages for pipeline management of discharged patients after Department of hepatobiliary surgery, which can significantly reduce the incidence of complications and infection, and improve the quality of life of patients and patient satisfaction, which is worthy of clinical promotion.

articleTitle: Global stability analysis of a class of SIRS models with nonlinear incidence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: In this paper, a SIRS epidemic model with vaccination and nonlinear incidence is discussed. The existence and uniqueness of this system are analyzed. By applying Hurwitz criterion, the local stability is proved. Finally, the global stability is researched by constructing the suitable Lyapunov functions in a new way [1],.

articleTitle: An analysis of the mediating effect of self-compassion on perceived stress and prosocial behavior among Intensive care unit nurses
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Objective: To explore the relationship among perceived stress, prosocial behavior and self-compassion of ICU nurses. Methods: A total of 425 nurses from three grade A hospitals in Hunan Province were investigated with Chinese Perceived Stress Scale (CPSS), Prosocial Tendencies Measurement Scale (PTM) and The Self-compassion Scale(SCS). Results: Prosocial behavior and perceived stress was negatively correlated (r=-0.365, P=0.032), and a positive correlation with self-compassion (r=0.258, P<; 0.001), and a negative correlation between perceived stress and self-compassion (r= -0.457, P= 0.025). The mediating effect between perceived stress and prosocial behavior was ab =0.366× 0.512=0.188, accounting for 44.87% of the total effect. Conclusion: Self compassion plays a mediating role between perceived stress and prosocial behavior, and is an important variable influencing prosocial behavior of nurses. Therefore, nursing managers should take active intervention measures to improve the self-compassion level of ICU nurses, reduce their perceived pressure, and then improve the level of prosocial behavior.

articleTitle: Chinese Experience of Stakeholder Coordination in the COVID-19 Crisis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: The COVID-19 event is a severe public health crisis and it is a test of the global crisis management system. China has made great achievements in the prevention and control of this crisis. Therefore, these measures have great reference value for other countries and regions. This paper takes the COVID-19 crisis as an example and conducts research from the perspective of stakeholders. First, the paper introduces the stakeholder theory. Second, a stakeholder analysis model for the public crisis is constructed and the core stakeholders, secondary stakeholders, and potential stakeholders of this crisis are analyzed. Third, the Chinese measures of stakeholder coordination are showed. At last, three lessons are summarized: improving the crisis management capabilities of core stakeholders, guiding secondary stakeholders to participate in crisis management, and appeasing the emotions of potential stakeholders.

articleTitle: SICR-Based Insurance Pricing of Hepatitis B Virus in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Studies on the hepatitis B virus have shown that male adults are more likely to be infected through sexual contact than female adults. This article establishs SICR models for under-aged children, male adults, and female adults, then performs numerical simulations on the data of Chinese hepatitis B infections from 2012 to 2017. Obtaining antibodies through vaccines and state transitions between ages are considered. Finally, based on this model, for a specific epidemic insurance payment model, the Disability Income Insurance (DII) model under the Markov chain assumption is used to price the epidemic insurance.

articleTitle: The Ethical Problems of Criminals
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: This thesis discusses the ethical problems of criminals by highlighting serial killers and the possible reasons behind their motive to commit crime. Over the years researchers have studied the phenomenon of serial killing and tried to elucidate the origin of it. Despite all studies about the categories of serial killers, their motives and the reason behind their complex psychological mechanisms, none of this have answered the question for why some individuals became serial killers or to why it had been difficult to reform them. Whether a man is a criminal or a public servant is purely a matter of perspective. Citing examples of popular serial killers like Jeffery Dahmer, Aileen Wuornos, Ted Bundy, this thesis aims in examining the different types of serial killers among different geographies and the ethical aspects of these killers. It also explains the nature and nurture theory that, whether these criminals are born or being made due to compulsion of their social circumstances. Some remedial measures to control and reduce such heinous acts has also been discussed. Off late it has been observed that such crimes have been diminishing in the last two decades and the possible reasons behind it has been examined.

articleTitle: The Clinicopathologic Analysis of Autism
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: This paper aims to discuss two main factors that can lead infants to suffer from autism. These two factors are abnormal genetic expressions in babies' central nervous system and environmental risks around them. The main content of this paper based on some cutting-edge researches made by scientists all over the world in recent years. By comparing and contrasting these experimental results, this paper will analyze the differences and similarities between them and find two possible ways to treat autism. These two ways can make contributions to the rehabilitation of autism or alleviate the autistic behaviors of the patients.

articleTitle: Rumination Effects on Depression in Adolescents
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: This paper discusses the effect of rumination on adolescent depression. Three experimental studies are introduced. One study is a longitudinal study of rumination as a cause of early to mid-term depression in adolescents. The results show that rumination affects the severity of depression and the probability of future depression by affecting the occurrence of negative events. The second study is a study of three kinds of negative repetitive thinking in children and adolescents. The results show that the indicators of repetitive thinking are positively correlated with depression and anxiety symptoms. The third study is the mediating role of rumination between maladjusted perfectionism and depressive symptoms. These results indicate that adolescents with high rumination level are more likely to suffer from depression than adolescents with low rumination level.

articleTitle: A Cluster-Based Approach for Extracting Redundancy-aware Top-k Co-location Patterns
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Spatial co-location pattern mining, which discovers interesting and potentially useful neighboring relationships among spatial features from spatial datasets, plays an important role in spatial data mining. However, as the scale of spatial datasets gradually increases, traditional co-location pattern mining algorithms generate numerous patterns, which may confuse, even mislead the following decision-making of the users. To solve this problem, this paper proposed a cluster-based approach to discover non-redundant top-k co-location patterns, where k is the number of generated patterns. In this proposed approach, first, the spatial data is transformed into transactions to calculate the distance between two co-location patterns, and then the k-means clustering method is adopted to classify the patterns into k clusters, finally, the outputs are generated by selecting one pattern from each cluster. The experimental results on both synthetic and real-world data sets demonstrate that our proposed approach effectively summarizes spatial co-location patterns.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mindfulness and Flow
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Although extensive research has investigated the various characteristics of mindfulness and flow states, few studies provided evidence that what features mindfulness and flow share commonly and whether they are compatible. The present study uses five valid self-report questionnaires in positive psychology and examines the relationship between mindfulness and flow, and the similarities and differences of both optimal experiences. Given the fact that some previous researches indicated that mindfulness and flow could coexist during college athletes' competitions, this study has verified that common people with little education of optimal experience could experience both states of mindfulness and flow. The result shows that mindfulness is significantly and positively associated with flow. The study suggests that the emergence of either flow or mindfulness may contribute to the interaction of external environment and internal reaction, which may have implications toward improvement of common people's mental health and productivity.

articleTitle: Ethical Issues of Child Abuse by Parents and Other People in Makassar City, Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Children are members of the community who are weak both in physical and in the fulfillment of their right to the determined age of their right sometimes divided unevenly into their parents. Acts of violence against children are acts of abuse that are carried out by parents, or others towards children. Forms of violence that occur can be physical, psychological, sexual, to social. Physical violence in Indonesia is now one of the threats for children and is known as a hidden household tragedy. In the meantime, almost always the crime that occurs in children in the family, by society in general, is not seen as a crime. In this study the method uses a quantitative approach, by using numbers to describe characteristics, namely the ethical problem of child abuse by parents and others. With a study sample of 10 people and calculating the average then assessed using the Independent Sample T-test The average value of abuse by parents is more dominant than abuse by other people. It is because parents thought it was a way of educating that the child would become a disciplined person.

articleTitle: Optimal design of Police Emergency Intelligence Mechanism under the Background of Major Public Health Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: In order to improve the emergency response ability and the response efficiency of the public security intelligence department, the existing public security emergency intelligence mechanism need to be optimized. In the context of major public health emergencies, this research proposes an optimized design for the existing police emergency management intelligence mechanism. In this regard, a total of five emergency mechanisms in three layers are proposed, which can improve the existing problems in the current public security emergency management work, enrich the theory of specialized emergency management information mechanism, and give enlightenment to the normalized police and health department's emergency practice.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Diagnosis Predictive Model of Alzheimer’s Disease with Few-shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease imposes a significant quality of life and socioeconomic burden on patients, while mild cognitive impairment is considered as the first stage of Alzheimer's disease. Therefore, being able to detect and treat the disease while it is in mild cognitive impairment is essential for effective prevention of Alzheimer's disease. Many scholars have proposed a variety of different AI diagnostic models for Alzheimer's disease. These models are mainly trained based on MRI image data. However, in addition to MRI images, clinical diagnosis data of Alzheimer's disease also includes data of multiple modalities such as MRI text reports and test results of mental and psychological scales. Moreover, in the actual clinical data, there are fewer samples of Alzheimer's disease data and lack of sufficient training samples. This paper proposes a classification and diagnosis method for Alzheimer's patients based on multi-modal feature fusion and small sample learning. Specifically, we use structured MRI image reports and corresponding MRI images as multi-modal input, and then the compressed interactive network is used to explicitly fuse the extracted features at the vector level; finally, the KNN attention pooling layer and the convolutional network are used to construct a small sample learning network to classify the patient diagnosis data. The experimental results show that the accuracy and Fl-score value based on multi-modality are improved by more than 10% compared with single-modality. Using the small sample learning method under the same multimodal data, the accuracy rate increased by 8.2%, and the Fl-score value increased by 8.4%.

articleTitle: Effects of Nutritional Therapy on Blood Glucose Levels and Pregnancy Outcomes in Patients with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Meta-Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Objective This meta-analysis aims to further evaluate the effect of nutrition therapy on the GDM patients during pregnancy, to provide a more reliable theoretical basis for the clinical promotion and application of nutrition therapy, so as to improve maternal and child health. Methods The literatures on nutrition therapy for GDM were obtained by searching PubMed, Cochrane Library, CBM, EBSCO, EMBASE and Web of Science, and the time range of the search was from the time of establishment of database to July 2020. Then the obtained literatures were screened based to the inclusion and exclusion criteria to extract the relevant data and evaluate the risk of bias from the included RCTs. Finally, the RevMan 5.3 statistical software provided by the Cochrane Collaboration was used for the meta-analysis of the extracted data. Results In this meta-analysis, 12 RCTs, a total of 837 patients with GDM, were included. The analysis results showed that there were not statistically significant differences between the nutrition therapy group and the control group in FPG (SMD =-0.50, 95% CI: -1.15~0.15, P=0.13), 2hPG (SMD=-0.01, 95% CI: -0.44~0.41, P=0.95), HbAlc (SMD=0.38, 95%CI: -0.90~1.65, P=0.56), cesarean section (RR=0.78, 95% CI: 0.60~1.01, P=0.06), polyhydramnios (RR=0.32, 95% CI: 0. 04~2.99, P=0.32) and neonatal hypoglycemia (RR=0.68, 95% CI: 0.35~1.30, P=0.24), but were statistically significant differences in maternal weight gain during pregnancy (SMD =-0.26, 95% CI: 0.48~0.04, P=0.02) and macrosomia (RR=0.19, 95% CI: 0.08~0.48, P=0.0005). Conclusion This meta-analysis indicates that nutrition therapy that change the amount of carbohydrates, fats, energy and low-GI or low-GL foods in daily diet can decrease the maternal weight gain during pregnancy and lower the incidence of macrosomia, and may reduce the occurrence of cesarean section in the patients with GDM; but it do not effectively improve other outcomes. Nevertheless, given the difference between this analysis and other systematic reviews, so the studies with more high quality in the future should be implemented to further explore more effective approach of nutritional therapy for GDM and determine the reliability of the results.

articleTitle: Association Between Sleep Duration and Cognitive Impairment: A Cross-Sectional Study Using the BRFSS Database
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Prognostic factors of cognitive impairment remain unclear. We conducted a cross-sectional study using the 2018 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) database to investigate the association between cognitive impairment and its potential risk factors, namely unusual sleep duration and previous military service. A total of 17,935 people was included in this study, of which 1790 (9.92%) reported experiencing cognitive impairment and 470 (2.62%) responded to cognitive impairment severity questions. We found significant associations for both inadequate and prolonged sleep duration (<; 7h, odds ratio (OR) =1.61, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.41, 1.81; >9h, OR =1.68, CI: 1.29, 2.12) with cognitive impairment; unusual sleep duration was also associated with more severe symptoms of cognitive impairment. Moreover, participants who had military experience were 48.85% more likely to experience cognitive impairment (OR =1.49, CI: 1.24, 1.78) and 1.82 times more likely (OR =2.82, CI: 1.08, 3.13) to have more severe symptoms. This is the first study that investigated prognostic factors of cognitive impairment using the BRFSS. This database covers a heterogeneous population of diverse age, ethnicity, and socio-economic background, which makes our results generalizable to a broad population in the US. Our results suggest that sleep duration and military service are significantly associated with cognitive impairment. Future prospective studies are needed to investigate whether there are causal relations for sleep duration and military service with the development of cognitive impairment.

articleTitle: Factors Associated with Depression among Older Adults in China: : A systematic review
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: In the past few decades, depression have increasingly contributed to older adults, and that makes older adults lose health. However, it has many unclear factors that influence depression disorders among older adults in China. This systematic review aims to find the factors associated with depression among older adults living in China. Ten articles included in this systematic review, and the ten articles were related to depression among older adults living in mainland China. In this systematic review found strong evidence of the relationship between older age (≥60 years) and depression. From this research found there have many factors that can affect depression among older adults living in mainland China, and the factors included of demographic characteristics, cognitive, health behaviors, physical health, health-promoting lifestyle, social support.

articleTitle: Analysis of Ethical Issues Involved in Wearable Equipment for Health Care
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: With the development and popularization of medical wearable devices, medical practice and health care provision are changing. However, the resulting daily large amount of personal data and privacy disclosure and other ethical issues related to interests are gradually highlighted. From the perspective of medical ethics, this paper summarizes and analyzes the ethical problems existing in the whole process of health medical wearable equipment serving human beings, including the equipment itself, data collection, data transmission, and management, and data use and puts forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions from the perspectives of respecting autonomy, informed consent, privacy protection, medical optimization, and favorable principles. “Prevention before disease, disease prevention, and change prevention”, and “medicine according to the case”, to give full play to the role of health care wearables in the field of medical care, promote the development of new intelligent medical care and help the construction of healthy China.

articleTitle: Causes of cancellation on the ophthalmic ambulatory surgery at West China hospital Sichuan university
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to determine the cancellation rate and reason of day operation in the Outpatient Eye Surgery Center (OASC) of West China Hospital of Sichuan University (WHC), and to propose appropriate solutions. A retrospective study was conducted to include all patients who planned to undergo surgery at OASC from June 2016 to December 2018. A total of 23,341 surgical cases were evaluated. The results showed that the cancellation rate was 10.2%, representing 2,382 cases. Factors related to the patient's physical condition are unavoidable (52.1%), such as colds, high blood pressure, high blood sugar, inflammation and menstruation. The avoidable rate was 47.9%. Patients needed to be rescheduled, patients abandoned treatment, were unable to contact patients, had completed surgery and were not adequately prepared before surgery. Studies show that more than 80 percent of cancellations are due to patients not showing up. Mobile healthcare applications can improve patient health knowledge, compliance and service satisfaction. At the same time, it can reduce the cancellation rate, reduce the cost of medical institutions, improve the efficiency of operation and management.

articleTitle: Thoughts of Human Destiny Community in Global Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Since the birth of mankind, human community has constantly been formed in the process of production and life of human beings, and evolved and developed. Marx's thought of “false community” and “real community” plays an important role in promoting development of human community. The concept of human destiny community inherits and develops Marx's thought of “real community” and is an important strategic thought in the new era. Under the background of the global epidemic, the concept of human destiny community is once again demonstrated. Where do nations go and where do mankind go? Only by adhering to the concept of human destiny community, unity and cooperation, common anti-epidemic, is the correct direction for development of the world.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis and Prevention Mechanism Construction of Occupational-Disease-Type Mass Incidents — Based on the Review of Silicosis Events in X County
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: With the high incidence of occupational diseases in China, occupational-disease-type mass incidents also show a tendency of "frequent occurrence" and "easy occurrence", which poses a severe challenge to China's modernization governance capacity and system. Mass incidents are also the difficulty, pain point and focus of China's social public management. Mass incidents we are facing are a major social issue that needs to be properly handled right now. Most occupational-disease-type mass incidents are problems left over from history, and the generation mechanism is multifaceted and deep-seated. Based on the review and analysis of silicosis events in X County, this paper systematically analyzes the occurrence mechanism of occupational-disease-type mass incidents, expounds and puts forward the effective resolution strategies as well as the construction of long-term prevention and governance mechanisms of occupational-disease-type mass incidents.

articleTitle: A study on the relationship between Job DemandControl-Support and Job Burnout of College English Teachers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: This paper aims to explore the relationship and effect of job-demand-control-support (JDCS) on job burnout, so as to provide evidence for reducing the occurrence of job burnout. It was a cross-sectional descriptive research design adopted, and 290 College English teachers from 10 universities in China were randomly selected to complete a series of questionnaires. The research tools were the Job Content Questionnaire (Chinese Version), Maslach Burnout InventoryEducators Survey (MBI-ES). SPSS 24.0 software was used for statistical analysis by using Pearson correlation analysis and hierarchical regression analysis. The results of this research were as followings: (1) job burnout, job demand, job control of College English teachers were in the upper middle level, social support was below the average; (2) job demand and job burnout were significantly positive correlated with each other (P$\lt \theta.\theta$ 1), job control had significant negatively correlation with job burnout (P$\lt \theta.\theta$1). there was a remarkable negative correlation between job burnout and social support (P$\lt \theta.\theta$1);(3) JDCS model had 82.1% explanatory power on the variance of job burnout. From the research it is shown that the incidence of job burnout of College English teachers is high. The job stress model of JDCS directly affects the job burnout of College English teachers. Certain job control and some support from superiors, colleagues can effectively reduce job burnout of College English teachers.

articleTitle: Age evolution characteristics and causes of cancer mortality in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: In recent years, malignant tumor has become the first “killer” endangering the health of Chinese. Most of the existing studies focus on the pathogenesis, regional distribution and influencing factors of malignant tumor, while few studies on the age evolution of cancer mortality rate. By collecting relevant data and using R/S fractal method, this paper obtains the age evolution trend and characteristics of the malignant tumor mortality rate of Chinese, that is, the mortality rate in various age groups will be declining in the next few years, but the downward trend of children, adolescents and young residents is more obvious, while that of middle-aged and elderly residents is relatively vague. In terms of the reasons, there are positive factors such as economic development, scientific and technological progress, environmental governance, the popularization of cancer knowledge, and the change of life style, and the negative factors such as environmental pollution, accelerated aging process, increased social competition pressure, bad living habits and other negative factors. Therefore, the government should continue to strengthen the control of environmental pollution and encourage the research and development of new anti-cancer technologies and new drugs. At the same time, the government should actively publicize the knowledge of cancer prevention and anti-cancer, improve people's awareness of self-care, and promote the early detection, early diagnosis and early treatment of malignant tumors, so as to reduce the mortality of malignant tumors.

articleTitle: Under the Background of Medical Alliances Construction a Simulation Study on the Residents’ First Diagnosis Choice Behavior at Basic-medical Institutions Based on SD Model : —Taking Jiangsu province, China as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Objective: Under the background of MAs construction, the SD model of residents' first diagnosis choice at the basic-medical institutions was established to observe the change trend of the number of first medical diagnosis at the basic-medical institutions and the hospital with Jiangsu province as an example. Methods: Combined with the background of Jiangsu MAs construction, the data of Jiangsu statistical yearbook from 2013 to 2017 were used to make a simulation analysis on the factors affecting the choice of residents' first medical diagnosis institutions by using the method of system dynamics. Results: All the five kinds of intervention behaviors can effectively affect the number of first medical diagnosis at the basic-medical institutions, but the effects are different. Conclusions: The model can objectively simulate the system structure and behavior rules, and can be used to predict the residents' choice of the first medical diagnosis institutions. Among the five interventions, the construction of internal information platform of MAs and the sinking of quality medical resources in MAs can maximize the first-diagnosis rate of residents at the basic-medical institutions, which is of great significance for optimizing the structure of medical diagnosis and treatment and guiding residents to seek medical diagnosis in an orderly manner.

Author Keywords: Choice of Diagnosis and Treatment Institutions

articleTitle: Impact of Vaccination Strategies For Epidemic Node-level SVIR Probabilistic Model : Pandemic simulation on social networks under various vaccination strategies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Public Health and Data Science (ICPHDS)
abstract: Vaccination strategies could be considered as either a site percolation problem, or one state of a node, which is more suitable for studying the imperfect vaccination. This paper conducts vaccination simulation on classic strategies including random immunization, degree based immunization, and acquaintance based immunization. In addition, two innovative vaccination simulations, which are the first neighbor and the second neighbor strategies, are also applied. All the simulations are run by the node level probabilistic SVIR model under random, scale-free, and small world network. We aim at finding out the best strategies under limited vaccination resource and different conditions of disease spreading parameters.
